question.prompt: Kattha the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (VRI) edition potthake ayaṃ pāṭho? "Khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā; Na hi pabbajito parūpaghātī, na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto." Ṭhānam eva vissajjehi, iminā ākārena: Dhammapada 144.

answer: No. (Ayaṃ pāṭho Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (VRI) potthakato na hoti; ayaṃ Sikkhānaṃ "Guru Granth Sahib" nāma potthakato Gurmukhī-lipiyā likhito pāṭho hoti.)

question.prompt: Ayaṃ pāṭho the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (VRI) edition potthakato? "ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਥੁ ਧਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸੋ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਈ" Āma vā no vā vissajjehi.

answer:
Khantī paramaṃ tapo titikkhā,
Nibbānaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhā;
Na hi pabbajito parūpaghātī,
Na samaṇo hoti paraṃ viheṭhayanto.

answer:
